stories.headline: Every fibre cut sets Nigeria’s digital economy back, but who pays?
stories.summary: Frequent fiber optic cable cuts by contractors and vandals in Nigeria are causing major disruptions to the country's digital backbone and telecom infrastructure. The recurring damage highlights significant enforcement gaps in statutory protections for critical infrastructure, raising unresolved questions regarding financial accountability and repair costs.

stories.headline: Airtel Nigeria puts its network map in subscribers’ hands
stories.summary: Airtel Nigeria has introduced a new feature called Airtel Open Network within the My Airtel Africa app. The feature allows subscribers to view active, upgrading, and planned 4G and 5G network sites within a 500-metre radius, while also enabling them to report network issues directly to the telecom operator.

stories.headline: Freshworks Swings To $18 Mn Profit In Q3, Revenue Rises 14% YoY To $245 Mn
stories.summary: Nasdaq-listed SaaS firm Freshworks reported a consolidated net profit of $18.3 million for the third quarter, swinging from a loss in the prior-year period. The company's revenue grew 14% year-over-year to $245 million, driven by continued adoption of its IT service management and customer service software.
